content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect assumption in the string indexing logic within the `while` loop. Specifically, the original code did not account for the possibility that the `StringBuffer` (`sb`) could be empty, which would lead to an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` when attempting to access the last character with `sb.charAt(sb.length() - 1)`. The patch added a check to ensure that `sb` is not empty before trying to access its last character, thus preventing the exception and ensuring the loop operates correctly.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect assumption in the string indexing logic within the `while` loop. Specifically, the original code did not account for the possibility that the `StringBuffer` (`sb`) could be empty, which would lead to an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` when attempting to access the last character with `sb.charAt(sb.length() - 1)`. The patch added a check to ensure that `sb` is not empty before trying to access its last character, thus preventing the exception and ensuring the loop operates correctly.

Subject: [PATCH] ND2: fix string indexing bug introduced in b48fd4a

---
 components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/NativeND2Reader.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/NativeND2Reader.java b/components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/NativeND2Reader.java
index 417137f02a..a733301faf 100644

+++ b/components/formats-gpl/src/loci/formats/in/NativeND2Reader.java
@@ -2413,7 +2413,7 @@ public class NativeND2Reader extends FormatReader {
       lines = textString.split(" ");
       for (int i=0; i<lines.length; i++) {
         StringBuffer sb = new StringBuffer(lines[i++]);
-        while (sb.charAt(sb.length() - 1) != ':' && sb.indexOf("_") < 0 && i < lines.length) {
+        while ((sb.length() == 0 || sb.charAt(sb.length() - 1) != ':') && sb.indexOf("_") < 0 && i < lines.length) {
